name: dot-pattern
title: Dot Pattern
description: A grid of small dots behind your content, with an optional radial or linear fade. Pure CSS, no JavaScript.

props.name: spacing
props.description: Distance between dots in pixels. Smaller values make a denser pattern.

props.name: color
props.description: Token color of the dots, already softened with opacity.

props.name: mask
props.description: Fade the dots toward the edges (radial) or toward the bottom (linear).

props.name: children / slot
props.description: Content shown on top of the pattern.

a11y: The pattern layer is aria-hidden and ignores pointer events, so only your content is announced and clickable.
Keep text contrast in mind: put the pattern on bg-surface or bg-canvas and use a mask behind long text.

ai.whenToUse: A quiet texture behind a hero, CTA card, empty state, or section without adding images.
rules: Set the background color, padding, and radius with class on the component
Use mask=radial behind centered text so the dots fade out under the heading
Use spacing between 12 and 28 for most layouts

id.description: Grid titik kecil di belakang konten, dengan pudar radial atau linear opsional. Murni CSS, tanpa JavaScript.

props.spacing: Jarak antartitik dalam piksel. Nilai lebih kecil membuat pola lebih rapat.
props.color: Warna token titik, sudah dilembutkan dengan opacity.
props.mask: Pudarkan titik ke arah tepi (radial) atau ke bawah (linear).
props.children / slot: Konten yang tampil di atas pola.

a11y: Lapisan pola memakai aria-hidden dan mengabaikan pointer, jadi hanya konten yang dibacakan dan bisa diklik.
Perhatikan kontras teks: pasang pola di bg-surface atau bg-canvas dan pakai mask di belakang teks panjang.

ai.whenToUse: Tekstur tenang di belakang hero, kartu CTA, empty state, atau section tanpa gambar.
rules: Atur warna latar, padding, dan radius lewat class pada komponen
Pakai mask=radial di belakang teks tengah supaya titik memudar di bawah judul
Pakai spacing antara 12 dan 28 untuk sebagian besar tata letak
